# Graincraft — Task Outline

## Template info

- **Name:** Graincraft
- **Original:** ColorLib Woodwork (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/woodwork/)
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/woodwork/
- **Stack:** Vite 8 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript

## Sections (in implementation order)

1. Navbar (sticky dark, logo, nav, CTA, mobile menu)
2. Hero (image slider, dark overlay, heading, CTA)
3. About (photo grid, heading, description, stats, CTA)
4. Services (4 cards on dark bg)
5. Testimonials (client quotes, photos)
6. Portfolio (image grid)
7. Choose Us (4 reasons with icons)
8. FAQ (accordion)
9. Footer (dark bg, links, Component Dock)

## Design tokens

- Brand gold: #bfb332
- Dark: #111111
- Light bg: #faf5f0
- Fonts: Josefin Sans (headings), Rajdhani (numbers/stats)

## Verification

- `bash scripts/verify-app.sh graincraft`
- 100% test coverage (lines, functions, branches, statements)
- No colorlib references in app code
- Footer links componentdock.com
